rdf:Description.skos:description: This ticket covers the refactoring of hardcoded global variables from `map_schema.py`. The goal is to move them to a central, configurable location to improve maintainability and flexibility.
rdf:Description.skos:scopeNote:
**Relevant Code Snippets:** ```python BASE_URI = 'https://data.archives.gov.on.test.gbad.ca/'
SISN = 'SISN' DATEEX_COLS = ['DATEEX_BEGINNING', 'DATEEX_END'] # ... and so on for all other global variables ```
rdf:Description.skos:changeNote: **Implementation Plan:** 1. **Move to `gbad_core/config.py`:** - Move all hardcoded global variables (`BASE_URI`, CSV column names, placeholder masks, `rico_authtp_dict`, etc.) to the new `gbad_core/config.py` module. - These can be stored in a structured format, such as a dictionary or a set of dataclasses, to make them easier to manage. 2. **Update Refactored Code:** - The new `CSVPreprocessor` and `RMLGenerator` classes will import these configuration values from `gbad_core/config.py`.
